title: FunnelStory, Explained by Story
author: Harsh's field book, November 2026
description: Everything about FunnelStory and the work you do there, told as stories you can picture: what the company sells and to whom, how data becomes a signal and a score, how agents are built and why they stay drafts, then each customer as its own story (GreyOrange, Trellix, Showpad, Descope, DocuSign and the rest), the people, and the habits that make the job work. Written to be read in free time, ten minutes a chapter, with check questions that feed the study lab. Client-confidential: this book never leaves this machine.
